svg.title: A braced bevel pair drives a perpendicular wheel axle
svg.desc: Top view. A motor at left drives a horizontal shaft supported by a bearing. A meshing pair of equal bevel gears turns the drive 90 degrees onto an axle toward the bottom of the page. A second bearing braces that axle before the wheel. Their extended centerlines intersect. The chassis travels right.

g.text: Carry motor rotation around the corner.
Brace both shafts so the bevel gears stay together under load.
The wheel axle is perpendicular to the motor shaft.
